notes.title: Update - Huge bug fixes, Cheats enabled!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We have been reading all of your comments on the Community Hub and have another update for you all. Hopefully this addresses most, if not all problems that have been raised.

Please let us know if you still experience issues on the Community Hub threads.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]The shark in savo island is bugged, its reef is stuck out side of water and does not move you can see this in the entry scene and during gameplay
[*]Corocodiles are bugged, they are completely avoiding to come out of water just like the patrol units they are bugged as long as you do not dive into water you will not make them move.
[*]Any units inside the houses and other locations which has entry element (doors + ladders + etc) is bugged, they do not interact with the world at all until you go inside the house. for example go inside shoot them before you kill them come out and they should chase you outside but they remain inside and dont come out and in other words game is paused for them until you go back to the house and it exactly starts from the moment you left last time.
[*]Any interaction with houses + windows + ladders is bugged and not working, such as sniper cannot snipe from windows anymore (when he is outside and you want to snipe the enemy inside a house by targeting the window) this does not work anymore his scope is not shown.
[*]white death mission theme is changed to C3 train mission theme
[*]some ladders are bugged, your character can not drop himself down when you tap on right click
[*]the old school cheats "gonzoandjan" are no longer working on both legacy and new edition – [b]New Cheat is PYROFOREVER[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Commandos Update for Modern Computers
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We are looking into all bug reports on our main thread. If you are experiencing any issues with the updates, please let us know here.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/6830/discussions/0/412448158145537410/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/6830/discussions/0/412448158145537410/[/url]

[b]UPDATE - You can now access the old build via the "Legacy Version" launch option[/b]

  Thank you all for your continued support for the Commandos series, we appreciate all the feedback we have received. We have heard all of your concerns and took them on board.

  With that, we have an announcement, all of the Commandos games should now run on systems up to and including Windows 10. Significant changes have been made to the code in order to make each of the games run correctly on modern machines.

Changelog for Commandos 2: Men of Courage
[list]
[*]Videos not loading bug fix.
[*]Fix for the game going slower than it should.
[*]Bug with the "comm2.exe" executable fixed.
[*]Performance problems fixed
[*]Compatibility issues with modern hardware fixed.
[*]New, higher resolution settings (1280x720)
[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

  We all hope you enjoy the update, and thanks again for all of your support!

notes.title: Announcement for Windows 10 Users
notes.content:
Hi,

It has come to our attention that unfortunately, the Commandos series will not run on Windows 10.

The reason for this is the lack of support for the older version of Direct X used by the game (Version 5)

While we continue to look for solutions to bring the Commandos series to more modern platforms, we unfortunately cannot offer any specific time frame for when this may occur due to engine's age.

As this is the case, we have two suggestions for anyone attempting to run the game in the Windows 10 environment:

1. Install a virtual machine such as VirtualBox or VMWare and run a virtual environment of Windows XP for improved compatibility. This is recommended but may not solve all issues.

2. If you have played the game for less than two hours, you can claim a refund via Steam.

- James
